prompt.project_info: Minimal bright-orange indoor bikini portrait adapted from the supplied prompt and approved-adult face reference.
prompt.main_subject: Clearly adult woman matching the supplied approved-adult face, long voluminous hair with curtain bangs, slightly sun-kissed skin with visible pores and dewy highlights, wearing a bright orange textured crinkle-fabric bandeau bikini top with ruffled edge and knotted tie detail, with a hint of white-and-green crochet shorts at the bottom edge.
